content: WhatsApp preview: reads og:image, wants ~1200x630 (1.91:1), absolute min 100x100 (below = no image at all), max aspect ratio 4:1, keep file under ~300-600KB or it frequently fails to load on mobile data. Only static JPG/PNG/WebP (no GIF). Caches extremely aggressively with no public debugger - once scraped, a URL's preview is frozen for days/weeks; the standard workaround is to bust cache via a query string (?v=2) on share, or run the URL through Facebook's Sharing Debugger 'Scrape Again' (shared crawler infra).
